# Digital-Mailroom: appendix {.page-title}

[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against `LLM-Mailroom-Services/Digital-Mailroom` `8b0bee5` on 30 October 2026.

## Package count

The hub README lists five core packages: `llm-dojo-scoring`, `llm-mailroom`, `The-Mailroom`, `local-mailroom-sandbox` and `mailroom-corpus-eda`. Four are built members. `mailroom-corpus-eda` is a virtual member (`package = false`) and is not installed. An older count of ten included packages the hub has since pruned. The case study keeps five, and names them.

## What is not on this page

Measured capstone results stay unpublished while the project is running. Expected completion is December 2026.
